notes: Opus design lane 2026-08-08. Headline: NO visibility concept exists in the codebase today; the one per-node flag (gis.track.visible, GPX ribbons only) is a live bug demo - hidden ribbons remain fully pickable/draggable because no picker filters on Bevy Visibility. fe-terrain LayerStack is the one real end-to-end visibility pipeline and should be generalized (ui_ux.md 167-172 already mandates a unified overlay registry). Recommended architecture: B+C hybrid (group registry = persisted petal-scoped addressable; membership = node property view.groups; per-node tri-state override view.state; solo = session-only resource). Non-negotiable rules: hidden => not spawned (guard the three spawners); one pure effective_visibility() resolver consumed everywhere; auth-carrying DbCommand for group writes (SetNodeProperty has zero data-layer authz). Phases 0-1 are file-disjoint from ui_semantics_unification waves and parallel-safe immediately; Phases 2-6 must serialize after it (plugin.rs 16-param ceiling, actions/mod.rs, pickers all mid-edit; Phase 5 needs UiAction::RevealSection from unification Phase 4).
